note: The Ghana Immigration Service's fee table (effective 15 May 2025) charges the work permit (companies) at US$1,293 for other nationals (US$647 ECOWAS, US$194 Ghanaians with a foreign passport); a rotator's permit of up to six months is US$647. GIS names no performers' route, no decision time and no term; a 2018 trade report (3news, quoting the creative-arts pressure group FOCAP) says foreign musicians and actors have often performed without any permit, which is practice, not the rule. Retry 2026-11-01: the 3news (2018) item quoting the pressure group FOCAP is dropped as a source (it names no official primary); its account is not held.
